title: Show subtle parser-to-form feedback
description: After parsing customer request text, users need a subtle but clear indication that the parser populated shipment details. Add transient visual/status feedback without making the UI busier.
close_reason: Added subtle parser-applied feedback chip, brief shipment form highlight, concise live status copy, and rebuilt/restarted Docker frontend.

title: Remove clipped right-pane scrolling
description: The populated quote result pane appears chopped because the right column becomes its own scroll container. Update the frontend layout so generated results participate in normal page scroll and remain visually complete.
close_reason: Removed right-pane internal scrolling/clipping, collapsed breakdown by default, rebuilt and restarted Docker frontend.

title: Reduce frontend UI density and add clear controls
description: The quote assistant UI feels busy, uses oversized type in the workbench, and the right pane has no clear/reset affordance. Add clear behavior, collapsible UX sections, and tighten typography while preserving the current design system.
close_reason: Implemented clear controls, collapsible UI sections, tighter typography, and verified frontend build plus Docker-served app.

title: Add Docker support for backend and frontend
description: Add containerization for the Go backend and Vite/React frontend, including Dockerfiles, compose wiring, runtime config, documentation, and verification commands. Preserve local development behavior and account for API_TOKEN/BACKEND_BIND_ADDR requirements.
close_reason: Implemented backend/frontend Dockerfiles, compose wiring, nginx proxy, docs, and verified builds

title: Revamp frontend UI with Minimalist Modern design system
description: Apply the provided Minimalist Modern design system to the React/Vite frontend. Centralize CSS tokens, improve typography, layout, responsive behavior, visual hierarchy, interactions, and accessibility while preserving quote/parser behavior.
close_reason: Implemented UI/UX revamp and verified with make test

title: Add backend request limits and server timeouts
description: The API uses http.ListenAndServe defaults, decodes request bodies without MaxBytesReader, and keeps unbounded in-memory quote history. Add HTTP server timeouts, body limits, quote history bounds, and API/store tests for large and repeated requests.
close_reason: Implemented fixes and verified with make test

title: Prevent quote ID collisions in rapid requests
description: Quote IDs use second-level timestamps and store quotes by ID in a map. Multiple quote requests in the same second can collide and overwrite history. Add a collision-resistant ID strategy and tests for rapid or concurrent quote creation.
close_reason: Implemented fixes and verified with make test

title: Fix parser null-array crash in frontend
description: Parser responses can encode nil Go slices as JSON null. App.jsx calls .length on extractedFields, missingHints, and warnings, so parsing can crash the React render. Normalize parser arrays in the API/backend response or guard the frontend render, and add focused coverage.
close_reason: Implemented fixes and verified with make test

title: Validate assistant model output before returning it
description: OpenAI output is parsed and returned as customer-facing summary/message without checking required fields, disclaimer language, or price consistency. Add validation and fallback behavior so prompt injection or malformed model output cannot change quote semantics.
close_reason: Implemented fixes and verified with make test

title: Add deployment-safe API access controls
description: The backend binds to all interfaces and quote endpoints are unauthenticated. For deployment beyond localhost, add an explicit host/bind configuration, authentication or API token controls for quote endpoints, and documentation for intended local versus deployed exposure.
close_reason: Implemented fixes and verified with make test

title: Avoid parser defaults overwriting existing form values
description: The parser always returns default shipment type, service level, pieces, and pallets. App.jsx merges the whole draft, so parsing a route-only request can overwrite existing user-entered form values with defaults. Merge only extracted fields or include explicit extraction metadata per field.
close_reason: Implemented fixes and verified with make test

title: Make frontend dependency wiring reproducible
description: frontend/package.json uses latest for React/Vite packages and the repo has no committed lockfile. Pin compatible dependency versions, commit a lockfile, and include frontend build/test verification in project-level quality gates.
close_reason: Implemented fixes and verified with make test

title: Fix documented backend .env setup
description: README and SUBMISSION say copying backend/.env.example to .env configures the server, but the Go backend only reads process environment variables. Either load dotenv files in local startup or update docs/scripts so OPENAI_API_KEY, PORT, and FRONTEND_ORIGIN are actually applied.
close_reason: Implemented fixes and verified with make test
